visual_action: A still photograph of the U.S. Capitol building is used as a background. Superimposed over the center of the image is a video clip of two cats. One cat is black and looks towards the camera with a weary or disappointed expression. The other cat is brown and fluffy, with its back mostly to the camera, and appears to be nuzzling or interacting with the black cat.

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads: "me when every single congressional Republican voted against legislation to tackle the climate crisis"

on_screen_text.text: me when every single congressional Republican voted against legislation to tackle the climate crisis

audio_music: A slow, somber, rhythmic electronic track ('Toquezin Do Capcap — Dj Luh Souza') plays throughout the clip, creating a mood of disappointment or seriousness.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a static background image with a superimposed video element. There are no cuts, zooms, or camera movements.
manipulation_or_satire: A video clip of two cats has been digitally cut out and superimposed onto a still photograph of the U.S. Capitol building to create a reaction meme.
cultural_references: The video uses the popular 'me when...' meme format, where a reaction image or video (in this case, cats with a judgmental expression) is used to represent the creator's feelings about a specific situation.
central_claim: Every congressional Republican voted against legislation intended to address the climate crisis.
intended_effect: To generate disapproval of congressional Republicans and portray them as obstructionists on climate change policy.
